result: regression 0.83x on the only shapes it can move (Wt band); parked at byte-identical default (2,)
evidence: band W4032 gamma_tile: 38399ns at (2,) vs 46136ns at (2,1); Rt=1 single block so depth 1 serializes reader/compute/writer
followup: Lamp L5 (row-resident W-chunked) removes STREAMs re-read without giving up depth 2; Lamp L1 restores many blocks per core

finding: Two distinct failure classes after unlocking fp32_dest_acc_en=False. (1) CATASTROPHIC (11 cells, PCC 0.55-0.99): pre-existing BLOCK_ROWS>1 bug, reproduces identically at fp32_dest_acc_en=True. transform_in_place ROTATES cb_row_stat (pop1/push1); with ring == BLOCK_ROWS a PARTIAL final block leaves the stats straddling the ring wrap and pass-B OperandKind::Col indexed read runs off the end. Invisible to Phase 0 because every Phase-0 cell had Rt<=64<110 cores => BLOCK_ROWS==1. Fixed by CB_ROW_STAT_DEPTH=2 (D6). (2) PRECISION (10 cells, W>=5120): FPU matmul reduce accumulates the within-tile 32-column sum in 16-bit DEST; error is INVARIANT across NUM_W_CHUNKS 4..112 and across REDUCE_BULK and math_fidelity, so it is not the cross-chunk accumulate. DEVICE_PRINT confirmed post-reduce sum 7904 vs true 7033 (+12.4pct) while the finalize is exact.
